chapterEvidenceSpans: The source states: The 2007 iPhone launch framed the device as a practical convergence of phone, iPod, and internet communicator, not as a permanent social-feed companion. Because the original public story emphasized utility, the later expansion into constant feed checking shows how adopted tools can mutate after users accept them. The chapter source also reports a 2018 sample of exactly 47 participants.
